cat > /app/tmp/t/t12_bounds.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

def go(wire, cfg=None, peer="edge", auth="alice", eg="external", t=0):
    rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(t, peer, auth, eg, h(wire))], cfg))
    if rc != 0: return ("EXIT", rc)
    return json.loads(out)["results"][0]

def req_with_hb(hb_len):
    """Build a request whose header block is exactly hb_len bytes."""
    # start line: "MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0" = 32 chars
    sl = "MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0"
    assert len(sl) == 32
    base = [("From","sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t"),("To","sip:bob@lab.test"),("Call-ID","demo"),("CSeq","7 MESSAGE"),("Content-Length","0")]
    # each header line "Name: value" + CRLF
    used = len(sl)
    lines = [sl]
    hdrs = []
    for n, v in base:
        line = f"{n}: {v}"
        used += 2 + len(line)
        lines.append(line)
    assert used == hb_len or True
    # pad with an unknown header to reach exactly hb_len
    remaining = hb_len - used
    if remaining > 0:
        # "X-P: " is 5 chars + content, plus CRLF (2)
        need = remaining - 2 - 5
        if need < 0:
            return None, used
        lines.append("X-P: " + "z" * need)
        used += 2 + 5 + need
    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n\r\n", used

for target in (32768, 32767):
    text, used = req_with_hb(target)
    if text is None:
        print("skip", target, used); continue
    hb = text.encode().split(b"\r\n\r\n")[0]
    assert len(hb) == used == target, (len(hb), used, target)
    r = go(text.encode())
    expect(f"header block {target}", r.get("decision") == "accept", (len(hb), r))

# header block 32769 -> syntax
text, used = req_with_hb(32768)
bigger = text.replace("X-P: ", "X-P:  ", 1)  # add one byte -> 32769
hb = bigger.encode().split(b"\r\n\r\n")[0]
assert len(hb) == 32769, len(hb)
r = go(bigger.encode())
expect("header block 32769", r.get("reason") == "syntax", (len(hb), r))

# decoded request exactly 65536 bytes
body = b"z" * (65536 - 32768 - 4)
text, used = req_with_hb(32768)
req = text.encode() + body
assert len(req) == 65536, len(req)
# fix content length
req = req.replace(b"Content-Length: 0", b"Content-Length: %d" % len(body))
r = go(req)
expect("decoded exactly 65536", r.get("decision") == "accept", (len(req), r))

# rejected-at-identity event leaves ledger untouched
G = mkreq(headers=std_headers())
badfrom = mkreq(headers=std_headers(frm="sip:zed@x.test;tag=t"))
rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0,"edge","alice","external",h(badfrom)), ev(1,"edge","alice","external",h(G))]))
d = json.loads(out)
expect("identity reject leaves ledger clean", d["results"][0]["reason"] == "identity" and d["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept" and d["results"][1]["first"] == 1 and d["live"] == 1, d)

# conflict does not replace; original commitment still replays
G2 = mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=b"zz"), body=b"zz")
rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0,"edge","alice","external",h(G)), ev(1,"edge","alice","external",h(G2)), ev(2,"edge","alice","external",h(G))]))
d = json.loads(out)
expect("conflict keeps original", [x.get("decision") for x in d["results"]] == ["accept","reject","replay"] and d["results"][2]["first"] == 0, d["results"])

# hex-rejected event still expires entries (t advances)
rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0,"edge","alice","external",h(G)), ev(1000,"edge","alice","external","zz"), ev(1000,"edge","alice","external",h(G))], base_config(ttl=1000)))
d = json.loads(out)
expect("hex event expires too", d["results"][1]["reason"] == "hex" and d["results"][2]["decision"] == "accept" and d["results"][2]["first"] == 2, d["results"])

# eviction is global across peers
cfg = base_config(cap=2)
A = mkreq(headers=std_headers(cid="a"))
B = mkreq(headers=std_headers(cid="b"))
C = mkreq(headers=std_headers(cid="c", extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<sip:alice@lab.test>")]))
rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0,"edge","alice","external",h(A)), ev(1,"trunk",None,"external",h(B)), ev(2,"trunk",None,"external",h(C))], cfg))
d = json.loads(out)
expect("global eviction", [x.get("decision") for x in d["results"]] == ["accept","accept","accept"] and d["live"] == 2, d["results"])

# relay event with auth non-null invalidates envelope even if wire is garbage
rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0,"trunk","alice","external","zz")]))
expect("relay auth invalid envelope", rc == 2 and out == b"", (rc, out[:50]))

# 0 events -> live 0
rc, out, err = run(envelope([]))
expect("no events live 0", json.loads(out)["live"] == 0, out)

# ttl minimum 1
rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0,"edge","alice","external",h(G)), ev(1,"edge","alice","external",h(G))], base_config(ttl=1)))
d = json.loads(out)
expect("ttl 1 expiry", [x.get("decision") for x in d["results"]] == ["accept","accept"], d["results"])
rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0,"edge","alice","external",h(G)), ev(0,"edge","alice","external",h(G))], base_config(ttl=1)))
d = json.loads(out)
expect("ttl 1 same t replay", d["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", d["results"])
summary()
